summary: Read-only review accepted the harness. No blocking findings: per-tick comparisons cover both Go hosts against the independent React oracle and host-to-host, state/full tree/ordered messages, actual HTML, disabled paths, and root outerHTML. Native traces retain ordered index/Step/state/tree/DOM fields; the Go SameDOM comparator checks those, while message order is checked directly with isDeepStrictEqual. The harness verifies two isolated WASM APIs, one init per host, dispatch/message counts, invalid-backend preservation, stale clicks after swaps, and the exact expected window.error manifest with unrelated browser/console errors fatal. Seeded scripts force real swaps. Nonblocking note: the unit test detects message-array differences by adding an item rather than explicitly permuting two items; implementation comparison is order-sensitive.
